caption: The drawing depicts a brown, cylindrical pottery water cooler with a lid that has a round knob on top. The body of the cooler features a raised relief of a bald eagle with outstretched wings, clutching arrows and an olive branch, and a shield on its chest. Below the eagle, there is text that reads, “NORWICH POTTERY WORKS / NORWICH / CONN.” On each side of the vessel, there are decorative leaf motifs in relief. The cooler has horizontal ridges near the top and bottom for added detail, and at the lower front, there is a circular opening likely intended for a spigot. The background is a light beige color, and the drawing is bordered by a thin, simple line. The artist's signature, "N. Amantea," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Water Cooler
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
